method: Synthetic closed-form population for the stated window. Dimension and fact row counts are authored from the cited industry anchors and from structural fan-out (every parent required by an always-match rule has at least one child). Distinct parent keys, unmatched parents, null foreign keys, and average children per matched parent are derived from multiplicity. Optional-child match rates default to 0.93 when a join does not set one. Optional-parent coverage defaults to the full parent population when matched children can reach it, and otherwise to one child per observed parent. A stated coverage or matched-row count overrides that default. This is not a sampled extract.

major_facts.landing: Online charging events are the finest usage landing zone. 3GPP treats a charging event as one chargeable-event report toward the charging function, which is finer than a closed CDR.
major_facts.basis: Authored at three events per mediated CDR. The mediated total is the published 2.1 billion CDRs per month, so the event fact is 6.3 billion rows.
major_facts.subject: charging

major_facts.landing: Quota reservations are the online-charging landing zone for held balance.
major_facts.basis: Authored as two reservations for every three charging events. Some charging events do not reserve.
major_facts.subject: charging

major_facts.landing: Balance debits are the landing zone for committed online-charging usage.
major_facts.basis: Authored as three debits for every four reservations. Unused reservations expire without a debit.
major_facts.subject: charging

major_facts.landing: Network attach and registration events land here, separate from billable CDRs.
major_facts.basis: Synthetic mobility volume for a 25 million subscription national network over 30 days.
major_facts.subject: usage

major_facts.landing: Rating output lands here, one charge per mediated CDR, before invoice assembly.
major_facts.basis: Equal to the 2.1 billion mediated CDRs. Optional one-to-one links partition that population across data, voice, SMS, and content CDRs.
major_facts.subject: charging

major_facts.landing: Policy-control decisions land here for session authorization and QoS.
major_facts.basis: Synthetic session-control volume, below the charging-event grain and above closed CDRs.
major_facts.subject: charging

major_facts.landing: Packet-data CDRs, including partial PGW and SMF records, are the largest mediated-CDR landing zone.
major_facts.basis: 1.4 billion of the published 2.1 billion monthly CDRs. Partial records are why data outnumbers voice.
major_facts.subject: usage

major_facts.landing: Mobility handovers land here, with separate source and target cell identities.
major_facts.basis: Synthetic radio-mobility volume for the 85,000-cell footprint.
major_facts.subject: usage

major_facts.landing: Included-allowance consumption lands here, optionally tied to a rated charge.
major_facts.basis: Synthetic draw volume for subscriptions that hold an allowance bucket.
major_facts.subject: charging

major_facts.landing: Location and tracking-area updates land here.
major_facts.basis: Synthetic mobility signaling volume, lower than handover volume.
major_facts.subject: usage

major_facts.landing: Voice call detail records land here.
major_facts.basis: 520 million of the published 2.1 billion monthly CDRs.
major_facts.subject: usage

major_facts.landing: Radio performance counters land here at 15-minute grain.
major_facts.basis: 85,000 cells times 96 intervals times 30 days = 244,800,000 rows. This is a periodic snapshot, not a CDR.
major_facts.subject: network

major_facts.basis: 150 million of the published 2.1 billion monthly CDRs.
major_facts.subject: usage

major_facts.landing: Billable charge lines for the cycle land here, after rating.
major_facts.basis: 16 million invoices times an authored average of 8 lines.
major_facts.subject: billing

major_facts.landing: Outbound roaming usage exchanged with partners lands here.
major_facts.basis: Authored as 6 percent of mediated CDRs (126 million), the outcollect slice of the 2.1 billion.
major_facts.subject: roaming
